negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-08-14, no token-specific public U.S. GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official application, or registered foreign-issuer exception was located for wARS or its Ripio/Moonbird issuer. Ripio materials identify an Argentine PSAV registration and local/regional compliance, not a U.S. permitted-payment-stablecoin pathway. The OCC rulemaking remains proposed, so the absence of a final authorization register is not itself evidence of approval.
